name: apex-client
description: Local bridge for ApexTunnel, proxying local traffic to the public internet.

scripts.build: pnpm run bundle && nexe dist/bundle.mjs --target linux-x64-18.20.0 --output bin/apex-client-linux-x64
scripts.build:all: pnpm run bundle && nexe dist/bundle.mjs --target linux-arm64-18.20.0 --output bin/apex-client-linux-arm64 && nexe dist/bundle.mjs --target linux-x64-18.20.0 --output bin/apex-client-linux-x64 && nexe dist/bundle.mjs --target windows-x64-18.20.0 --output bin/apex-client-win-x64.exe
scripts.build:termux: pnpm run bundle && nexe dist/bundle.mjs --target linux-arm64-18.20.0 --output bin/apex-termux --build --verbose

author: BraveraTech
